kohima-village: Should we write Kohima Village, Kewhira or Bara Basti when asking for a tutor?

Any of the three works, as long as you add a landmark. Kewhira is the older name and Bara Basti the historical one, and all point to the same settlement on the high north-eastern side of town. The nearest point a taxi can reach helps a new tutor most.
How does a tutor get up to a home in Kohima Village?

Usually by taxi or bus to the nearest road point, then on foot. Homes are spread across the slope, so tell the tutor where the vehicle should stop and which path leads to your door. On a first visit, a phone call from that stop saves a lot of searching.
Can a tutor from Kitsübozou also teach children in Kohima Village?

Yes, easily. Kitsübozou lies right beside the village, so one tutor can cover homes in both, and tutors from Daklane or Naga Bazaar, a little further into town, are also practical. Short trips like these make a fixed weekly slot simple to keep through the school term.
What happens after a Kohima Village family sends a tuition request?

NXTutors sends two or three matched tutors, starting with those living near the village, then across North Kohima, then the rest of the city, then online. You see each tutor's fee before booking, and the first class with the one you pick is a free demo.
peraciezie: Where exactly is Peraciezie within Kohima?

At the northern end of the city. Peraciezie is the first of the nineteen municipal wards and shares this part of town with Bayavü Hill and Sepfüzou, while Naga Bazaar lies to its south-east on the way into the centre. Tutors living in those wards are the nearest match.
What should we send a tutor before the first visit to a Peraciezie home?

A map pin and a landmark. As across hilly Kohima, many homes here sit above or below the road on stepped paths, so the tutor needs to know where to leave the taxi or two-wheeler and which steps lead to your door. That one message avoids a slow first visit.
Which evening slot suits a tutor travelling to Peraciezie from the southern wards?

One that avoids the hour when offices close. The trip north passes through the busy central stretch of town, so a slot starting a little after that rush is easier to keep on time. Several neighbourhood schools sit close by, so an evening lesson fits after the school day, including for HSLC students.
Does a Peraciezie family have to accept the first tutor NXTutors suggests?

No. NXTutors offers two or three matched tutors so you can compare them, with each tutor's fee on the profile before you book. The first class is a free demo, and if the tutor you choose stops suiting your child later, switching to someone else costs you nothing.
bayavu-hill: Is the Nagaland board office really in Bayavü Hill?

Yes. The head office of the Nagaland Board of School Education stands at Upper Bayavü Hill, so the ward sees regular visitors on working days. It is handy for HSLC or HSSLC registration questions, though a home tutor's job is the study plan, not the paperwork.
Why should a family tell the tutor whether they live in Upper or Lower Bayavü Hill?

Because lanes climb between the two levels, and starting at the wrong one wastes a first visit. Name the level, a nearby landmark and where a taxi or two-wheeler can stop. Families on the Sepfüzou side of the same municipal ward should mention that name too.
Which tutors are closest to a home in Bayavü Hill?

Those in Peraciezie, its immediate neighbour, and in Naga Bazaar, the next ward towards the town centre. With visitors to the board office adding to working-day traffic, a later afternoon or evening slot is usually smoother, and online is a sensible fallback in the June to September monsoon.
Can a Bayavü Hill student try a tutor before paying for regular classes?

Yes. The first class with any tutor NXTutors matches is a free demo, and you see that tutor's fee before you book it. Each request brings two or three options to compare, and if you later want a different tutor, making the switch costs nothing.
naga-bazaar: Does it matter whether we live in Upper or Lower Naga Bazaar?

Yes, so mention it when you book. The ward is split into Upper Naga Bazaar and Lower Naga Bazaar, and naming the right part sends the tutor straight there on the first visit. Add a landmark and the point where a taxi can drop off, and the search is over quickly.
Why is Naga Bazaar convenient for tutors coming from the town centre?

Because it links the older northern neighbourhoods with the centre. Daklane and New Market lie just to the south, with Peraciezie and Bayavü Hill to the north-west, so tutors from several wards pass close by. Those who do not live nearby usually finish the trip by taxi.
How should a Class 10 student in Naga Bazaar plan tuition for the HSLC examination?

With a fixed weekly routine started early in the year. A tutor from Naga Bazaar itself or from Daklane, New Market or Kitsübozou can visit on set days, and extra online sessions can be added before tests without changing the home timetable that the student relies on.
How does NXTutors pick tutors for a Naga Bazaar request?

Nearest first. NXTutors looks at tutors around Naga Bazaar, then those elsewhere in the North Kohima & Kohima Village zone, then the rest of the city, and finally online tutors. You receive two or three options, each showing the fee, and the first class is a free demo.
kitsubozou: Can one tutor cover both Kitsübozou and Kohima Village?

Yes, and that is often the simplest arrangement. Kitsübozou sits right beside Kohima Village, so a tutor living in either can teach in both and keep travel short. Daklane and Naga Bazaar, just to the west, are the next places to look for a tutor close to home.
What tuition suits children in Kitsübozou at different ages?

Homework support for younger children and board preparation for older ones. With a few primary and private schools in the ward, younger students often want help with daily lessons, while Classes 9 to 12 need a tutor who knows the HSLC or HSSLC papers or the CBSE syllabus.
Which slot is easiest for a tutor coming to Kitsübozou from the southern wards?

A later evening slot. Traffic gathers in the centre when offices close, and the route from the south crosses it before climbing from the Naga Bazaar side. Share a landmark and where a taxi can stop, since homes spread over the slopes, and go online on heavy-rain days between June and September.
Is a demo class with a Kitsübozou tutor charged?

No, the first class with a tutor matched by NXTutors is a free demo. You see the tutor's hourly fee on the profile before you book, choose from two or three matched tutors, and can change to another tutor later at no cost to your family.
daklane: Why is Daklane one of the easier wards for a tutor to reach?

Because it sits in the middle of town. Naga Bazaar lies to the north, New Market to the south, and Kitsübozou and Kohima Village a short climb to the east, so most routes across the city pass through or near it. Tutors arriving by bus, taxi or two-wheeler all find it easily.
When should Daklane families schedule home tuition to miss the market traffic?

After the morning and evening peaks have passed. Daytime traffic is heavier around the central market, so an after-school slot that begins once the busiest period eases tends to run smoothly. Fix the same start time each week so the tutor can plan the trip around it.
Which boards and classes can a Daklane family ask a tutor to cover?

Anything from primary classes to Class 12. Students on the Nagaland Board of School Education can ask for HSLC or HSSLC experience, CBSE students for a tutor who knows that syllabus, and less common subjects can go to an online tutor when nobody nearby takes them.
What do I see before booking a demo for my child in Daklane?

Each tutor's fee. NXTutors shows it on the profile of every one of the two or three tutors matched to your request, so you can compare before the free first demo. Tutors near Daklane are listed first, then the rest of the zone, the city and online.
new-market: Is New Market easy to give as an address to a tutor?

Yes, it is one of the most familiar addresses in Kohima for anyone travelling by taxi or bus. It sits in the central stretch, just south of Daklane and north of Midland, so give the ward name first, then a landmark and the house details for the last part.
Where can a visiting tutor park a scooter in New Market?

Often only if the home has a spot, because parking on the central roads can be tight. Mention any space for a scooter when you book; otherwise the tutor may prefer to come by taxi and walk the short last stretch to your door.
How do New Market families handle two senior subjects in Class 11 or 12?

Sometimes by combining a home tutor and an online tutor. A student taking science or commerce under the HSSLC might keep a tutor from Daklane, Midland or Naga Bazaar at home for the core subject and add an online tutor for the second, timed after the evening peak.
Can we change tutors later if the New Market match does not work out?

Yes, and switching costs nothing on NXTutors. Every request brings two or three matched tutors, nearest first, so you have options from the start. The first class is a free demo, and each tutor's fee is visible on the profile before you book it.
midland: Which part of Midland should we mention when asking for a tutor?

Upper, Middle or Lower Midland, whichever is yours. The ward was incorporated in 1970 and is divided into these three neighbourhoods, so naming the right one sends the tutor to the correct part of the hill on the first visit. A landmark near the house helps too.
Which neighbouring wards can tutors reach Midland from?

Officers' Hill to the west, the Chandmari wards to the south and New Market just to the north. Tutors living in any of these can reach Midland easily by taxi or two-wheeler, which makes a regular weekly slot simpler to keep through the whole school term.
Are weekday mornings or evenings better for home tuition in Midland?

Later evenings usually work better on weekdays. Midland sits close to the town centre, so its roads are busiest when offices open and close. In the rainy months from June to September, moving a session or two online keeps the study plan on track without losing a week.
How many tutors does a Midland family hear about from NXTutors?

Two or three, chosen nearest first. NXTutors starts with tutors in and around Midland, moves on to the Main Town & Midland zone, then the wider city, then online. Fees are on each profile before you book, and the opening lesson with your choice is a free demo.
officers-hill: Is Officers' Hill the same place as Thegabakha?

Yes. Thegabakha is the official name of the ward most people call Officers' Hill, on the western side of central Kohima. Give both names when booking, so a tutor checking a map finds the right neighbourhood without doubt, and add the landmark your family normally uses.
Where should a tutor leave a two-wheeler at an Officers' Hill home?

Wherever you suggest, so say it in advance. The hill roads here can be narrow, so point out a spot to park and which gate or set of steps leads to the house. That single message spares the tutor a slow search on the first visit.
Which tutors can reach Officers' Hill without a long ride?

Tutors living in Midland, New Market, PR Hill or the Chandmari area. Officers' Hill sits between the town centre and the southern wards, with Midland to the east and PR Hill and Merhülietsa to the south and west. Weekday evenings near the market are busiest, so start a little later.
Can an Officers' Hill student check a tutor's board experience before regular classes?

Yes, during the free demo. NXTutors matches two or three tutors, and a Class 9 to 12 student on the Nagaland board or CBSE can use that first class to see how the tutor handles the syllabus. Fees are shown before booking, and switching later is free.
upper-chandmari: How do we stop a tutor confusing Upper Chandmari with Lower Chandmari?

Say clearly that you are in Upper Chandmari and give a landmark. The two are separate wards with similar names, which are easy to mix up when giving directions. A map pin and the point where a taxi can stop make the first visit straightforward for the tutor.
Can Upper Chandmari students stay with a home tutor through Class 12?

Yes. A higher secondary school in the neighbourhood means many students here study through to Class 12 close to home, and tutors from Lower Chandmari, PR Hill or Midland can keep visiting through those years. Matching the tutor's board experience matters most in the senior classes.
When should an Upper Chandmari family plan extra sessions for HSLC or HSSLC?

Early, before the winter. Board-year students usually want more sessions from the winter onwards, so fixing the timetable well ahead keeps a slot with the same tutor. During the heaviest monsoon weeks, between June and September, an online session can replace a home visit.
What do home tutors in Upper Chandmari charge per hour?

Each tutor sets their own fee, shown on the profile before you book. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.
lower-chandmari: What landmark helps a tutor find a home in Lower Chandmari?

A large place of worship opened in 2017 is the landmark most people use for directions here. Mention it to a tutor coming from Midland, along with the nearest stop where a taxi can drop off and whether there is space for a scooter at your home.
Which neighbourhoods do tutors usually come from to teach in Lower Chandmari?

Mostly Upper Chandmari, Midland and New Market, all close by. Weekday roads towards the town centre are busy at office hours, so late-afternoon or evening slots tend to suit tutors travelling from those wards and make it easier to keep the same time every week.
How often should a young child in Lower Chandmari see a home tutor?

Two or three times a week often works well for younger children. Older students can keep a home tutor for core subjects and add online classes in subjects such as accountancy or computer science, so the senior timetable is covered without extra travel for anyone.
What does NXTutors send when a Lower Chandmari parent asks for a tutor?

NXTutors sends a shortlist of two or three tutors, starting with those who live closest and widening to the Chandmari & PR Hill zone, the city and online. You can read every fee before choosing, and the opening class with your choice is a free demo.
pr-hill: What landmark should we give a tutor coming to PR Hill?

The Capital Cultural Centre, a well-known public venue in the ward that most taxi drivers recognise. From there, guide the tutor with a nearby landmark and say which level of the slope you live on, because homes are spread up and down the hill.
Does PR Hill include Lower PR Hill for tuition requests?

Yes. The municipal ward covers PR Hill, Lower PR Hill and one adjoining neighbourhood, so tell the tutor which part you are in. Lower PR Hill has its own schools, so students here range from primary classes up to the board years.
Which neighbourhoods around PR Hill can tutors travel from?

Officers' Hill to the north, Upper Chandmari to the east, and Agri Farm and Merhülietsa to the west. Tutors from any of these can reach PR Hill for regular sessions, and families often keep one weekly class online during the rainy months from June to September.
Can a PR Hill student on the Nagaland board get a tutor who knows that syllabus?

Yes, mention the board in your request. NXTutors matches two or three tutors with the right board and subjects, nearest first, and CBSE students can ask in the same way. You see each fee before booking, and the first class is a free demo.
lerie: Which neighbourhoods are grouped with Lerie in the ward list?

New Ministers' Hill and New Reserve. Together with Lerie they form one municipal ward at the southern end of Kohima, so families in any of the three can give Lerie as the reference and add their own neighbourhood name and a landmark when booking a tutor.
Which tutors are most practical for a family in Lerie?

Those living in Agri Farm, PR Hill or the Chandmari wards, which are the closest. Tutors from the northern wards must cross the busy centre to reach this southern end, so later evening or weekend sessions usually suit them better than a weekday slot straight after school.
What should a Lerie family tell the tutor about the house before the demo?

A landmark, where a taxi can stop, and whether the house is above or below the road. Kohima is built on hill slopes, so that detail saves the tutor a search. When heavy rain sets in between June and September, an online session keeps the week's work moving.
If the first Lerie tutor is not right, can we try another?

Yes. Switching tutors on NXTutors is free, and each request already brings two or three matched options to compare. Families on the Nagaland Board of School Education can ask for HSLC or HSSLC experience, and every tutor's fee is visible before the free first demo.
agri-farm: We live in Upper Agri; should we say Agri Farm when booking?

Yes, give both names. Upper Mediezie, known locally as Upper Agri, sits in the same municipal ward as Agri Farm, along with the Electrical and Forest neighbourhoods. Naming your own neighbourhood as well stops the tutor searching between them on the first visit.
Is Lower Agri part of the Agri Farm ward?

No. Lower Mediezie, or Lower Agri, belongs to the adjoining ward with Merhülietsa, even though the names sound alike. If your home is there, say Lower Agri and Merhülietsa in the request so the tutor heads to the right side of the hill.
Which tutors live closest to Agri Farm?

Those in PR Hill, the next neighbourhood to the east, and in Lerie and New Ministers' Hill to the south. Weekday traffic towards the town centre builds up at office hours, so early-evening sessions that begin after the peak are smoother for tutors coming by taxi or two-wheeler.
How can an Agri Farm student in Class 11 or 12 cover a specialist subject?

Through an online tutor, which NXTutors can match alongside a home tutor. Each request brings two or three options, starting with tutors nearest to Agri Farm and widening to the zone, the city and online. Fees are shown before booking and the first class is a free demo.
merhulietsa: Yes. In the municipal ward list, Merhülietsa also covers Lower Mediezie, known locally as Lower Agri. Families there can use either name, but mentioning both, plus a landmark, helps a tutor who knows the area by only one of them.
Where in Kohima is Merhülietsa, and which hill overlooks it?

On the western side of the city, next to Agri Farm and Officers' Hill, with Pulie Badze, the peak to the south-west, overlooking it. Hillside paths here can be steep, so give the tutor the nearest road point where a taxi can stop and a landmark before the first class.
How should a tutor from the northern wards time a trip to Merhülietsa?

Around the evening rush, not through it. Merhülietsa is on the western edge of town, so a tutor from the north crosses the centre, and a slot that starts before or after the busiest hour works better. Tutors from Agri Farm, PR Hill or Officers' Hill are nearer.
Can NXTutors find a Merhülietsa tutor who knows the NBSE or CBSE paper pattern?

Yes. List the board in the request and NXTutors matches two or three tutors, closest first. You read each tutor's fee before booking and can use the free first demo to check how well they know the board's paper. Switching later costs nothing.
